title: Denver Botanic Gardens
content: Denver Botanic Gardensby James Gurney,casein, 5 x 8 inchesWe visit theDenver Botanic Gardens, a world class destination for outdoor painting.It's hard to choose between the bonsai garden, the lily pads, the orchids and bromeliads, and the native prairie grass environment. Jeanette and I decide on a view from the Romantic Garden toward the Herb Garden.It's a study in greens, so I emphasize a variety of different shades of green, and set up spot-contrasts with adjacent red-violets and red-browns.
